prefix.description: SEL-400G Advanced Generator Protection System (product identifier)

part_number.note: 23-character SEL-400 series MOT string. NO relay Model Option Table (ordering-information) document exists for the SEL-400G — the only 400G ordering doc in the corpus, WI-16396, is the Connectorized wiring harness (Part Number WA0400GA...) and was rejected. Positions were derived from the master-configuration drawing layers (i7200.C / i7307.B / i7308.B), the IM “Models and Options” section (1.12–1.14), and observed part numbers. Drawing-anchored positions (high confidence): 7 (connector type), 8 (Ethernet), 16 (mounting), 18/20/22 (interface board slots B/C/D). Position 17 (rack size 6U/7U/8U) is cross-validated: PNs with 17=6 select the 6U drawing (Slot B only), 17=7 the 7U drawing (Slots B+C), 17=8 the 8U drawing (Slots B+C+D). Positions 9, 10, 13, 14, 15 encode the analog/current, power-supply and conformal-coat sub-options; without a coded MOT their digit→value mappings could not be resolved (they are firmware-masked as 'X' in the sample CONFIGURATION INFO part number), so they are marked low confidence with the values observed. Slot-B/C/D input-voltage sub-codes (19/21/23) are likewise inferred (low).
references: SEL-400G Instruction Manual PM400G-01 (400G_IM_20250919), Models and Options 1.12–1.14; CONFIGURATION INFO screen (real part number)
SEL-400G master configuration drawings i7200.C / i7307.B / i7308.B (drawing layers)
WI-16396 rejected: Connectorized SEL-400G wiring harness (WA0400GA...), not the relay MOT

example_part_numbers.note: Real part number read from the IM CONFIGURATION INFO front-panel screen. 8U rack (pos17=8), screw-terminal, (4) 10-100BASE-T Ethernet, all-5 A current inputs (pos11=1, matches the shown all-5 A analog boards), horizontal rack, three INT2 boards at 125 Vdc in Slots B/C/D. 'X' digits (9,10,14,15) are firmware-masked, not literal options.
8U drawing example (i7200.C): Slots B=INT2/125V, C=INT2/125V, D=Empty.
6U drawing example (i7307.B): rack 6U (pos17=6), Slot B=INT7/125V only.
7U drawing example (i7308.B): rack 7U (pos17=7), Slots B=INT2/125V, C=INT2/125V.
